card.learned_from: 尾形光琳《八桥莳绘螺钿砚箱》（18 世纪）、清康熙《宫苑仕女图》黑漆嵌螺钿屏风（17 世纪晚期）
card.line: 黑漆屏风在暗室里展开，一支金笔沿折扇写出一条走势，转折处嵌进螺钿
card.fit: 时间轴、增长曲线、东方题材的发布片
card.score: 五声羽调的慢曲，D 羽
card.instruments: 古琴泛音和滑音、低弦长音、钟
card.sounds_like: 屏风展开一口长气，笔走一路沙沙，每颗螺钿嵌进去一声细响

motion.fold: panels turn 80° → 25° (ease-out, 1.35 s), flatten to 11° for the title, fold back 0.85 s in-out
motion.brush: the line follows an in-out sine over 2.7 s; the brush tip is always on the line's head

texture.reflection: one soft window band per panel, placed by the panel's angle

study.work: Writing box with Yatsuhashi (Eight Bridges) design (八橋蒔絵螺鈿硯箱)
study.by: Ogata Kōrin; Tokyo National Museum, National Treasure

study.work: Women in a Palace (a large folding screen, black lacquer with mother-of-pearl and gold-foil inlay, 286.1 × 752 cm)
study.by: unknown maker; The Metropolitan Museum of Art, 2001.76a–l
